response.rationale: Nineteen of twenty cited studies, including several T1 meta-analyses (Liu 2018, Uchihara 2019, Montero Perez 2013), link input (reading, listening, viewing) and exposure frequency to incidental vocabulary gains, and the one negative item (Feng 2020) only found similar gains across modalities rather than no gains. The evidence mostly shows that input and repetition predict gains. It doesn't isolate comprehensibility itself, which is why confidence isn't higher.
